headline: Trump lashed out at Zelenskyy: 'Zelensky doesn't know what he's talking about...'
dek: Trump lashed out at Zelenskyy: 'Zelensky doesn't know what he's talking about... Maybe it's time for Zelensky to get someone else to negotiate...
fault_line: Is Trump dumping Zelenskyy to end the war — or handing Putin the win?

sections.what_happened: Trump lashed out at Zelenskyy: 'Zelensky doesn't know what he's talking about... Maybe it's time for Zelensky to get someone else to negotiate... We've given a lot to Ukraine, they've given nothing to us.' AA earlier: 'I think it's time for somebody else to negotiate on behalf of Ukraine because... They're losing their male population.'
sections.what_verified: AA and Axios report the same thrust independently; consistent with Zelenskyy's accusation that Trump pressures capitulation.
sections.what_disputed: None on the quotes themselves; context: Trump still pursuing Oslo talks with Zelenskyy attending.
sections.why_matters: Truth side: the rupture is real and on-record; pair with the senators' readout and Vance. Debate-bait close.
sections.context: Background: Trump: 'time for someone else to negotiate on behalf of Ukraine'; 'Zelensky doesn't know what he's talking about'

totw_analysis: Our read: Truth side: the rupture is real and on-record; pair with the senators' readout and Vance. Debate-bait close. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is Trump dumping Zelenskyy to end the war — or handing Putin the win?
